data.name: Fatooh
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Fatooh means 'Raiser' or 'Opener'. This name holds a significant place in Islamic history as it was given to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) when he was taken to Jerusalem during the Mi'raj (Ascension to Heaven). The name symbolizes the opening of the way to God and the raising of one's spiritual self towards Him.
